fusions.name: Cold Spike, Driven Home
fusions.desc: Drives a cold spike through the target into the ground. It deals 32 damage, ignoring the target's resistances, and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bog Ore Scatter
fusions.desc: Flings 3 lumps of bog ore at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave the target [Muddled] for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Mortsafe
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Shod in Grey
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you have 10% arcane resistance.
